source_title: The Official Nintendo Switch 2 Pro Controller Drops to $67.59 at Woot Ahead of Black Friday
source_excerpt:
I don't think we'll see a better deal during Black Friday.
As part of its outstanding early Black Friday video game sale , Woot (which is owned by Amazon) is offering an official Nintendo Switch 2 Pro controller for just $67.59 after you apply 20% off coupon code after you apply an extra 20% off coupon code " SAVETOBER ". If you're a new customer, the discount goes up to 30% off. Amazon Prime members get free shipping, otherwise add $5 for delivery. This is an "international" model with a 90-day Woot warranty. It is brand new and will work perfectly fine on your US-based Switch 2 console.
Nintendo Switch 2 Pro Controller for $67.59
The original Switch Pro controller is still compatible with the new Switch 2. However, the new Pro controller brings a host of improvements to the table, including:
A new "C" button for GameChat (new to Switch 2)
The only disadvantage of the Switch 2 Pro controller besides having to go out and pay money to get one is that it's not backwards compatible with the original Switch console. Check out our Switch 2 Pro controller review .
Eric Song is the IGN commerce manager in charge of finding the best gaming and tech deals every day. When Eric isn't hunting for deals for other people at work, he's hunting for deals for himself during his free time.
